title: Satwik-Chirag Conquer China Masters Title, Set Tone for Asiad Defence
indian_angle: India's top men's doubles pair secured a significant BWF Super 750 title, marking a strong start to their Asian Games title defense preparations.
summary: Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty won the China Masters, defeating their Chinese opponents in a thrilling three-game final, overcoming previous runner-up finishes at the event.

title: BAI Announces Advanced Coaches Course in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course is crucial for enhancing coaching standards across India, directly impacting the development of future Indian badminton talent.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) is organizing a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026, to upgrade coaching expertise.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships Begins
indian_angle: This camp at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati is vital for preparing India's promising young players for upcoming international junior championships.
summary: The Indian team coaching camp for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 has commenced at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, focusing on developing junior talent.

title: Final Selection Trials for World Junior Championships 2026 Announced
indian_angle: This notification details the eligibility and qualified players for the final trials to select India's representatives for the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: BAI has released the player eligibility criteria and list of qualified players for the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026, to be held in Cairo, Egypt.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Implemented for Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: This significant rule change in domestic U13, U15, and U17 tournaments will fundamentally alter gameplay and strategy for young Indian players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has implemented a new 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships across the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
